== How to use this page ==
This page collects the proposals to change [[Contributors]], from a typo to a new proof, and their discussion. A proposal is opened with the pencil button next to a paragraph in the [https://endipa.github.io edition], or with the link ''new proposal'' under the title of the page (for a section, a statement, a proof). Reply to a proposal with ''Support'' or ''Oppose'', a reason and your signature (<nowiki>~~~~</nowiki>); an associate editor decides, and an editor writes accepted proposals into the page. Questions and ideas for new results go to Zulip, channel ''#contributing''. See [[How to contribute#Proposing a change|How to contribute]].
